facts.fact: Mordor Intelligence projects the DOOH market to surpass $25 billion USD by 2030, growing over 7% annually.
facts.quote: The DOOH market is projected to surpass [$25 billion USD by 2030](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/digital-ooh-market), growing over 7% annually.

facts.fact: A study cited by Ocean Outdoor finds that large-format DOOH captures about 5× more attention than standard online formats.
facts.quote: Studies show large-format DOOH captures about [5× more attention](https://oceanoutdoor.com/blog/the-attention-dividend-premium-large-format-dooh-commands-5x-more-attention-than-digital-channels) than standard online formats.

facts.fact: According to eMarketer, DOOH accounts for 36.3% of total OOH revenues, up 9.4% year over year.
facts.value: 36.3% of total OOH revenues; up 9.4% YoY
facts.quote: DOOH now accounts for [36.3% of total OOH revenues](https://content-na1.emarketer.com/sports--tech--ai-rewriting-rules-of-ooh-advertising), [up 9.4% year over year](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/ooh-advertising-statistics).

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that programmatic DOOH campaigns can be launched and optimized in days rather than weeks.
facts.quote: programmatic activation reduces friction: campaigns can be launched and optimized in days rather than weeks, offering more operational agility and efficient budget management.

facts.fact: In a StackAdapt case study (Somebody Digital for Ramsbury), a programmatic DOOH campaign achieved a 32% lift in brand recall.
facts.quote: achieved a 32% lift in brand recall and 15% higher store visitation rates compared to control regions.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that the average digital impression lasts barely 2.5 seconds, as cited in its blog post on OOH advertising.
facts.quote: where the average digital impression lasts barely 2.5 seconds
